edits.modify_from: Override it only if continuity in the supplied interval positively tracks that same carried cube being released or falling outside the bin.
edits.modify_to: Override it only if the supplied interval unambiguously tracks that same carried cube through release to outside the bin. A same-color detection appearing after release, even near the release pose or withdrawing hand, does not by itself identify the carried cube. Do not infer identity continuity from color, proximity, or appearance timing alone. A detection appearing lifted off the table during release likewise does not by itself establish a failed deposit.
